test.create_query: CREATE TABLE t_top_k_prewhere ( key UInt64, ts DateTime, user_id UInt32, message String ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY key SETTINGS index_granularity = 8192
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO t_top_k_prewhere SELECT number, toDateTime('2026-01-01 00:00:00') + cityHash64(number, 1) % 31536000, cityHash64(number, 2) % 500, concat( ['GET', 'POST', 'PUT', 'DELETE'][cityHash64(number, 3) % 4 + 1], ' /api/v', toString(cityHash64(number, 4) % 3 + 1), '/items/', toString(cityHash64(number, 5) % 1000000), ' status=', toString([200, 201, 204, 400, 404, 500, 502, 503][cityHash64(number, 6) % 8 + 1]), ' latency_ms=', toString(cityHash64(number, 7) % 5000), ' request_id=', lower(hex(cityHash64(number, 8))), if(cityHash64(number, 9) % 5 = 0, ' error=upstream timeout', ' ok')) FROM numbers(20000000) SETTINGS max_insert_threads = 8
test.query: SELECT key, ts, message FROM t_top_k_prewhere WHERE user_id = 42 AND message LIKE '%timeout%' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT key, ts, message FROM t_top_k_prewhere PREWHERE user_id = 42 WHERE message LIKE '%timeout%' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT key, ts, message FROM t_top_k_prewhere WHERE user_id = 42 AND message LIKE '%timeout%' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 10 SETTINGS use_top_k_dynamic_filtering = 0
